# ANALYSIS: BASELINE_ENGINE_WFO_REALFILLS

**Filed:** 2026-07-08
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The baseline engine's edge capture (currently $780) and Sharpe (4.340) are stable out-of-sample and produce similar P&L when using real OPRA fills on the three J anchor days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04). We test whether walk-forward OOS performance degrades significantly and whether real-fill slippage alters the anchor-day edge.

## Mechanism

Walk-forward OOS: split the 16-month sample (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) into expanding windows; train on prior 12 months, test on subsequent 3 months, rolling forward. Compute edge_capture and aggregate Sharpe for each OOS window, then average. Real-fills validation: replay the three J anchor days through the cached OPRA bid/ask series with slippage model, compare engine P&L to BS-sim baseline.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (per OP-20 template).
2. **Sample bias:** 16-month sample (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) includes all J anchor days; selection is chronological, not random; overfit risk mitigated by walk-forward design but still present if regime shifts.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward test not yet executed).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (OPRA validation not yet executed).
5. **Failure modes:** worst day could be a large gap against position (e.g., 5/07 call loss); max drawdown historically ~-$2,273 (from leaderboard); blow-up scenario: consecutive loser days with slippage causing catastrophic stops.
6. **Concentration:** top-5 days contribution unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest.

## Pre-merge gate

Gym validators must pass; walk-forward OOS must show edge_capture >= 771 and Sharpe degradation < 30%; real-fills validation must show <20% P&L deviation on top 3 J days; no new rule breaks introduced.
